commonBlocks.locationsLink: For clinic locations and hours, please visit: https://mountsinaifertility.com/contact-us/
commonBlocks.disclaimers:
Important Notes:
* Cancellations require 2 business days notice. Failure to provide notice will result in a fee of $80.00 for review appointments and $140.00 for new appointments. Appointments will not be rescheduled until the balance is paid in full.
* You must have a valid health card to receive care. Please ensure you and your partner (if applicable) bring a valid health card to your in-person appointment and update us with any change to your health card number.
* Fertility treatment fees are available on the Mount Sinai Fertility website: https://mountsinaifertility.com/more-information/fees/.
* Mount Sinai Fertility (MSF) is a teaching clinic of the University of Toronto. Medical students, residents and fellows may be involved in your care under the direct supervision of Dr. Michaeli.
* Our team involves both male and female health care providers and MSF cannot accommodate requests based on provider gender.
* For virtual appointments, Dr. Michaeli may connect up to 30 minutes after the scheduled start time. Please do not log off OTN.
* You must be in Ontario for your virtual consultation. If you are not in Ontario, we will need to reschedule to a later date.

ultrasound.name: Abdominal/Transvaginal Ultrasound
ultrasound.instructions:
• Abdominal/Transvaginal Ultrasound
    • To book your tests at Mount Sinai Fertility, on the first day of your period, call 416-586-4748 option 2 (voicemail service) or email: MSFmessage.MSH@sinaihealth.ca
    • Full bladder is required for the ultrasound.
    • If no period, call/email as above and receive instructions from the nursing team.

hsg.name: HSG (Hysterosalpingogram)
hsg.instructions:
• HSG (Hysterosalpingogram)
    • To book your test at Mount Sinai Fertility call 416-586-4748 option 2 (voicemail service) or email: MSFmessage.MSH@sinaihealth.ca
    • You will be asked to book an appointment between day 6-11 of your cycle (counting day 1 as the first day of your period).
    • You may experience cramping, similar to period cramps during the test. You may take over-the-counter pain medication such as ibuprofen 1-2 hours before the test.

noShow.name: No Show / Late Cancellation
noShow.subject: Mount Sinai Fertility - Missed Appointment for {{patientFirstName}}{{partnerFirstName}} - Action Required
noShow.bodyNoShow:
Dear {{greeting}},

We noticed that you were unable to attend your scheduled appointment with Dr. Michaeli.

As per the clinic's cancellation policy: "If for any reason you cannot make your appointment, we require a minimum of 2 business days' notice. Failure to provide 48 hours business notice to change or cancel an appointment will result in a fee of $80.00 for review appointments and $140.00 for new in-person appointments. Appointments will not be rescheduled until the balance is paid in full."

Once payment has been received in full, I will be happy to reschedule your appointment with Dr. Michaeli at our next availability.

If you have any questions or believe this was sent in error, please don't hesitate to contact us.

{{signature}}

{{disclaimers}}
